text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"NEXT FRONTIER Gaze upon it With all your 
might Forge ahead～～♪"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Foooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Phew... We sang quite a bit, time to head 
home. Thanks for inviting me out!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And next up~~!? Exhaustion is where the 
real fun begins! Let's get even more hyped 
up♪

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Please say sike... She's been singing for 
half a day already!?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We can still keep going! Let's get hype! 
Break through the roof of your heeeeart!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna force you, but... that 
feeling of breaking past your limits? I 
bet you'd love it too, Tap.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Palmer...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, bring it on! I'll get 'Happy' 
too, and soar right past the 'Peak'!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yoooi-sa, yoi-sa, yoooi-sa, yoi-sa! Dance, 
dance, dance like crazyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho! Heave-ho! Heave-ho! 
Heaaave-hooo!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Can you do it?! You ready for this?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Pappaka rappappaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Final stretch! Let! 'Em! Haaaaave 
ittttt!!"

text_block_list.name: Tap and Others
text_block_list.text: Don't stop! No, don't stop'til finish!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
How's that... I've surpassed it, my 
limit!! Ahahahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"The world looks brighter than usual! I 
feel great!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Tap Dance City was doing 
sprint training. As the final rep began—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa! Normally, I'd be hitting my 
limit around now—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: And next! YEEEEAAAAH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Phew... How's my time, Trainer!?
choice_data_list:
This is an all-time best...! What did you 
do?
This is the best ever...! What did you do?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I was taught the secret to surpassing 
limits! Yeaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having shed her old skin, Tap Dance City's 
running gained a whole new level of 
sharpness!
